newsitem.title: UK: Salomon starts Munich Re cover as hold.
newsitem.headline: Salomon starts Munich Re cover as hold.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Friday it had initiated coverage of Muenchener Rueckversicherung, the world's largest reinsurer, with a hold recommendation.

The broker's London based insurance analysts said Munich Re was set to grow further following its acquisition of American Re, but added that the company "maintains an excessively strong balance sheet and we estimate that two-thirds of the capital base is surplus to requirements."

Salomon also said that opaque disclosure made it one of the most difficult European insurers to value. "Unfortunately, the quality of Munich Re's operations is difficult to discern in its financial reporting ...Earnings are vastly understated."
"Until disclosure improves, it is very difficult to identify an attractive valuation handle and the shares are likely to remain closely correlated to the German bond market."
Munich Re should grow more quickly than primary insurers, but Salomon noted that it is geographically less well diversified than some other reinsurers.

On this basis Salomon set a 12 month price target of 3,700 marks, compared with a current 3,675. The shares have risen 40 percent in the past six months, partly because of their inclusion in the DAX index since September 23.
